whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Elite gaming zone,

I noticed your gaming zone has great 4.5★ reviews in Phulwari Sharif, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for tournament registrations and hourly bookings.

Maine aapke gaming zone ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, console/PC pricing, aur game library integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/elitezone

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Elite gaming zone team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and high-performance gaming vibe for Phulwari Sharif. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact pricing, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
